title: Cardinal Pellevé's secretary to Jean de Piles, abbé d'Orbais, Rome, 23 August 1589, BnF fr. 3413 no. 62

steps.what: Fetched fr. 3413 no. 62 and the three bound keys (nos. 53, 61, 69) from Gallica.
Tested the three bound keys: no. 53 numeric (letter has no figures), no. 61 Italian with other signs, no. 69 gives square = e where the letter needs n.
Tomokiyo's nevers.htm identifies the Nevers-Piles cipher and reads 'Cassin'; his partial table confirms W V ÷ 9 ◻ = Cassin.
Cribs from the clear context: 'la protection', 'vostre', signature b-a-r-o-? (Baron).
Annealed unread glyphs in their clear-text context under a French 6-gram LM (solve.py); groups too short, only the signature 'baron' stabilises.
Aligned BnF fr. 4715 f. 2 (same cipher, interlinear decipherment) word by word: confirms 4=h, 3=d, 1=de, ∇=m, += l and adds 7=d, z=b, H=n, δ=t, q=s, g=i.
With the added values: 'depeschera', '[code] mon maitre a esté retiré', 'vostre regne'; groups C, H, I and code signs ⌘ Ƒ τ ʃ unread.

outcome.fraction_read_source: NOTES: 'about 30 signs' open of the 90 signs in solve.py's ten groups (group-by-group tally of the readings in NOTES gives about 51-60 read)

gaps.item: Code signs ⌘ Ƒ τ ʃ (title/subject codes in groups S1 and G)
gaps.detail: No key entry; context suggests 'Monseigneur le Cardinal' for ⌘ Ƒ τ.

gaps.item: Group S2 'Ƒ 3 tt h Ⱥ ◻' (le doyen? a guess)
gaps.detail: Would need more sign values from a full transcription of fr. 4715 f. 2.
NOTES name the next step: a full transcription of fr. 4715 f. 2 (~900 signs, interlinear decipherment) to recover the key; not done.

outcome.notes: NOTES.md has no '## Remaining gaps' or '## Escalation' section; the gaps above are sourced from its 'Open groups' and 'Other sources tried' sections. The letter's substance is in clear.
